title: Because semi lucid in mall world
content: I unfortunately only have a small memory of the dream. It was a rather ugly part of the mall. Wide hallways, brown rug, tan beige walls. Dull yellow lights. Major back room vibes, but still has a quasi public feeling to it. Very few other people but I was with a man. All of a sudden I realized "this is mall world" I told him. He asked me what that was and I explained it was a bizarre dream location shared by many people and persistent to some degree. He didn't say anything in response but looked at me with horrified disgust. I became disappointed that I was in such a crappy part of the mall and wanted to explore more interesting parts. That's all I recall, and was maybe 15 seconds of dream time. Just a flash.
